categories.main_business_segments: Ya Horng Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of electronic audio products, small household appliances, and medical devices. The company’s main product lines include professional audio equipment such as DJ turntables and mixers, as well as small home appliances like juicers, coffee machines, and dehumidifiers. It also engages in OEM/ODM manufacturing and international trade related to these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced digital audio technologies including direct drive motor turntables with high torque and automatic beat control. Production involves automated assembly lines, precision quality control instruments, and integration of software and hardware for product innovation. Manufacturing processes include plastic molding, metal stamping, electronic component assembly, and strict quality assurance systems certified by ISO9001 and ISO13485 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ya Horng serves major global brands in the professional audio and small home appliance sectors, with key customers located primarily in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Asia. The company targets professional DJs, recording studios, and consumer markets demanding high-quality audio and household products. It also focuses on medical device OEM partnerships and expanding its customer base in smart home medical equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing bases and sales offices in Taiwan, mainland China (Dongguan), and the Philippines, with production facilities in Southeast Asia to diversify risk and reduce costs. Its major sales markets include the United States (over 50% of sales), Japan, Europe, Germany, and other Asian countries. The company actively expands overseas markets and maintains flexible production services aligned with international trade dynamics.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ya Horng operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as an OEM/ODM manufacturer, producing finished electronic audio products and small household appliances. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers such as plastic and metal industries and sells finished goods downstream to global brand customers and distributors. The company also manages inventory and production processes to optimize supply chain efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company invests significantly in R&D (about 3.68% of revenue) focusing on electronic audio messaging, smart medical devices, and small household appliances with innovative features like IoT connectivity and AI smart functions. It collaborates with academic and research institutions to enhance core technologies and aims to develop high-value-added products such as digital mixers, electronic musical instruments, and smart home appliances. Future R&D emphasizes product diversification, quality improvement, and compliance with international medical device regulations.
categories.revenue_model: Ya Horng generates revenue primarily through product sales of electronic audio equipment, small household appliances, and medical devices. Sales are conducted via OEM/ODM contracts with major global brands, with revenue recognized upon delivery and transfer of control to customers. The company also earns income from rental of investment properties and financial assets, but the core revenue stream is product manufacturing and sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the professional audio and small home appliance markets against global and regional manufacturers, including large home appliance brands and emerging Chinese competitors. Ya Horng positions itself as a high-quality, technology-driven OEM/ODM partner with strong R&D capabilities and stable customer relationships. It emphasizes product differentiation, quality, and innovation to maintain a competitive edge in niche professional audio and health-related appliance segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Ya Horng reported consolidated net operating income of approximately NT$3 billion in 2022 with a net profit after tax of NT$332 million and earnings per share of NT$3.72. The company has maintained stable profitability with a focus on cost control and inventory management despite global supply chain challenges. It has a solid asset base of over NT$3.4 billion and equity of about NT$2.6 billion, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ya Horng emphasizes high product quality, technological innovation, and customization capabilities to deliver differentiated value to customers. Its unique offerings include advanced digital DJ turntables, integrated electronic musical instruments, and smart medical devices compliant with stringent international standards. The company leverages its strong R&D team, quality certifications, and flexible manufacturing footprint to provide competitive pricing, reliable supply, and tailored solutions that meet evolving market demands.
